design_inspiration: A numbered document index leads visitors through the challenge, deployment loop, platform and FAQ. Engineering drawing labels and separate data-tool, enterprise and research paths give the technical story a distinctive structure.

Introduces Memo through specific household chores before explaining its learning technology. Labeled uncut demonstrations, privacy and safety sections, and a clear beta route address common buyer questions in sequence.

A five-step explanation follows aluminum from fuel production through transport, generation and byproduct recovery. Section navigation lets technical readers jump directly to core technology, system overview and applications.

Connects the industrial-heat problem to an Estimate Your Savings simulator, then explains four practical benefits. A named WEPA deployment gives visitors a concrete project to explore before making contact.

Explains centralized versus distributed power before segmenting the offer into data centers, energy storage and electric mobility. Each application gets concise technical-benefit bullets rather than one undifferentiated feature list.

Builds the opening story around uncertainty in wind and solar, then introduces storage technology and separate commercial, grid and renewable-generation use cases. The plain-language bigger-tanks-not-bigger-factories comparison makes scaling easier to understand.

Separates AI data-center buyers from utilities and independent power producers, giving each a dedicated case and outcome. Product, deployment strategy and updates form a compact navigation structure around a cost-focused proposition.
